_comment: Laptop Deal Radar - user-facing knobs. Edit these, then run: python scripts/collect.py

purchase_ceiling._comment: Delivered per-unit hard ceiling from the used-laptop-agent-fleet valuation method. Listings above it are marked as breaching the ceiling.

anchor_fallback._comment: Benchmark = what a TESTED, WARRANTED machine of that generation costs at 16GB/256GB. NOT the used-lot street price - those are a different market, 30-50% lower. A live scan overrides a (family, generation) pair only when 3+ observations agree. Refit 2026-10-01; the previous 8th/10th gen values were carried over from used-lot pricing and were ~40% too low.

11.note: LaptopReno + GotLaptopParts each list a Latitude 5420 i5 16GB/256GB at $203.99; corroborated upward by eBay 'very good' $235 and Back Market $273

10.note: ThinkPad T14 Gen 1 i5-10310U 16GB/256GB: Wisetek Market $243.71 and Newegg $244.70. Single model, snippet-sourced - the weakest tier, replace with eBay data first

8.note: page-verified: Alamogeeks Latitude 5400 i5 16GB/256GB $249.98, Woot Latitude 7490 i5-8350U 16GB/256GB $269.99; snippet: Newegg 7490 $219.00 + $19.99 ship

default.note: fallback when a generation cannot be resolved - set to the lowest tier so an unknown spec is judged conservatively

craigslist._comment: batch=N walks US regions in sequence: 1=sfbay 2=seattle 3=newyork 4=boston 7=losangeles 8=sandiego. Only batches answering 200 are used; 400s are skipped. Keep the request count modest - this is an undocumented internal endpoint.
